# VAppCloud Provider

Manage VAppCloud resources with short-lived, role-based credentials. Every API request is signed with SigV4 and credentials are never persisted in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"
  required_providers {
    vappcloud = {
      source  = "vappcloud/vappcloud"
      version = "~> 2.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "vappcloud" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) Temporary access key ID generated by the VAppCloud Access Portal. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID`.
- `api_url` (String) VAppCloud API base URL. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_API_URL`, then `https://api.4lock.net`.
- `ca_certificate` (String) Custom CA certificate PEM or path to a PEM file.
- `credential_process` (String, Sensitive) Command that returns AWS credential_process version 1 JSON. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_CREDENTIAL_PROCESS`.
- `endpoint_overrides` (Map of String) Optional service-specific base URLs keyed by the first API path segment (for example `projects` or `vmms`). Intended for testing and staged rollouts.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate verification. Use only with controlled development endpoints.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum retry count for retryable API failures. Defaults to 5.
- `proxy_url` (String) Optional HTTP(S) proxy URL. The standard proxy environment variables remain supported when this is unset.
- `rate_limit_per_second` (Number) Optional client-side request rate limit. Zero disables limiting.
- `request_timeout` (String) Timeout for each HTTP request in Go duration syntax. Defaults to `30s`.
- `retry_max_wait` (String) Maximum delay between retries in Go duration syntax. Defaults to `30s`.
- `role_arn` (String) IAM role ARN used with web identity. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_ROLE_ARN`.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Temporary secret access key generated by the VAppCloud Access Portal. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`.
- `session_name` (String) Web identity session name used for audit records. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_SESSION_NAME`, then `terraform-provider`.
- `session_token` (String, Sensitive) Temporary session token generated with the access key pair. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_SESSION_TOKEN`.
- `web_identity_token_file` (String) Path to an OIDC token file used with role_arn. The file is re-read before each refresh. Defaults to `VAPPCLOUD_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE`.
